verdict.rationale: Digits' own marketing claims automated reconciliation, started before month-end, with transaction flagging, smart reviews and surfaced exceptions. Separately, deduplication is described as automatic rather than surfaced for review. The evidence never describes reconciling a specific bank account against the ledger or showing matched, unmatched and duplicate items for an accountant to review. Missing for 10: per-bank-account reconciliation workflow docs, explicit matched/unmatched views, a duplicate-review queue (duplicates are only auto-removed), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can reconcile each bank account against the ledger with matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions surfaced for review
